Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-hiv-eac-register-virologic-failure-cause-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-eac-register-virologic-failure-cause-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
1a Missed dosesThe client missed one or more ART doses.
1b Abnormal or irregular dosing frequencyThe client took ART at an abnormal or irregular frequency.
2a Drug–drug interactionA drug–drug interaction is suspected to have contributed to virologic failure.
2b Drug–herb interactionA drug–herb interaction is suspected to have contributed to virologic failure.
2c Drug–substance interactionA drug–substance interaction is suspected to have contributed to virologic failure.
3 Other suspected causeA suspected cause not represented by another register code; describe it separately.

name: NgHivEacRegisterVirologicFailureCauseCS
title: NG HIV EAC Register Suspected Causes of Virologic Failure
description:
Codes printed in the Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register for
recording the suspected cause or causes of virologic failure after EAC.
